title: PLUR1BUS module manifest (module.json, module API 1)
description: D14. One source for the TypeScript validator (@plur1bus/module-api) and the supervisor (crates/plur1bus/src/modules). Reserved names and the entry-path rules live here too (H3B-R11), so both sides agree.

name.description: Module name; equals its directory under modules/. `core` and `supervisor` are reserved.

apiVersion.description: Module API major the module is written against, as a decimal string without leading zeros (B12).

entry.description: Entry script, relative to the module directory: `/`-separated segments that do not start with a dot, so no absolute path, no drive letter, no backslash, no `.` or `..` segment (it cannot leave the directory).

needs.description: Modules that must be ready first; `core` is the core.

provides.description: Capabilities this module offers to others.

consumes.description: Capabilities this module uses, from the core (memory, agent, jobs, events) or another module's `provides`.

extensionPoints.description: Extension points this module offers: `chain` runs handlers in sequence, `collect` in parallel with merged results (B11: validated and listed, not dispatched in 2a).

scope.description: `installation`: one instance; `agent`: one instance per agent (B10: not started in 2a).

lifeline.description: The module exits when its supervisor connection closes.

priority.description: Start priority and band: 0–99 foundation, 100–199 core services, 200–299 services, 300–399 aggregators, 400–499 orchestration, 500–999 add-ons.

configSchema.description: JSON Schema for this module's `modules.<name>` config object.
